title: Repeated equal-length word patches
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a set, let $c_t:\mathbb{Z}\to\operatorname{Option}(\Gamma)$ be a tape, let $c_p\in\mathbb{Z}$, and let $u,v$ be finite words over $\Gamma$ of equal length. Patching the tape first with $u$ and then with $v$, both at $c_p$, gives the same tape as patching it once with $v$.
